Hi, I'm **Raxitkumar Solanki**, also known professionally as **Raxit Solanki**.
I work on data engineering, streaming systems, and machine-learning
infrastructure, using Go (Golang), Python, Apache Kafka, AWS, and Google Cloud.
My [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/raxit65535/) connects this

## Research and publications

My research background connects distributed computing and applied machine
learning with earlier work on educational software and connected-device security:

- **Streaming data pipelines:** my 2019 CSUF thesis,
  [Git-Archive Data Pipeline](../publications/git-archive-data-pipeline/index.qmd),
  explores scalable pipelines and streaming graph processing with Kafka and Flink.
- **Applied machine learning:** I coauthored
  [Prediction of Crop Cultivation](../publications/prediction-of-crop-cultivation/index.qmd)
  for IEEE CCWC 2019, comparing regression approaches for crop-yield prediction.
- **Distributed analytics:** I am the first-listed author of the CCWC 2019 paper
  on [Hadoop and Apache Mahout](../publications/hadoop-apache-mahout/index.qmd).
- **Educational software:** my 2016 article
  [Online Examination Empowerment](../publications/online-examination-empowerment/index.qmd)
  describes a Java-based examination-preparation framework developed at Ganpat University.
- **IoT security:** my 2016
  [survey article](../publications/iot-security-concerns/index.qmd)
  examines connected-device applications and security concerns.

The [Publications collection](../publications/index.qmd) preserves complete author
lists, venues, source links, and citations. These published records are distinct
from my current [research interests and exploratory workflows](../research/index.qmd).
